title: Fuse workspace configuration
description: The root-only fuse.json contract read by Fuse 4.4. Fuse reads configuration only from the repository root and accepts no other keys.

$schema.description: The schema identifier. Informational; it lets editors validate this file.

workspace.description: An in-repository .sln, .slnx, .slnf, or .csproj used by explicit semantic indexing and compiler-backed requests. Relative paths resolve from the repository root and must not escape it.

ignore.description: Extra directory names or paths excluded from inventory, combined with .fuseignore and the built-in exclusions.
